Definition: to cut off; specifically to shear a flock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to shear, mow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shear; 1a2) shearer (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be cut off, be destroyed
